import z3

# Define the solver
solver = z3.Solver()

# Variables: group[w][p] for week w=0..6, player p=0..29, value 0..9
groups = [[z3.Int(f'g_{w}_{p}') for p in range(30)] for w in range(7)]

# Constraints: each group[w][p] in 0..9
for w in range(7):
    for p in range(30):
        solver.add(groups[w][p] >= 0)
        solver.add(groups[w][p] <= 9)

# For each week, each group has exactly 3 players
for w in range(7):
    for g in range(10):
        count = z3.Sum([z3.If(groups[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(30)])
        solver.add(count == 3)

# For each pair of players, they share a group at most once
for p1 in range(30):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, 30):
        together = z3.Sum([z3.If(groups[w][p1] == groups[w][p2], 1, 0) for w in range(7)])
        solver.add(together <= 1)

# Solve
result = solver.check()
print(result)
